errors.text: The proposed Cr addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark-plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo at 1000 °C.
No Cr concentration, alloy composition, processing schedule, oxidation temperature, corrosion electrolyte, or magnesium-volatilization limit is specified.
The claimed mechanical improvement has no proposed causal pathway, and the oxide-film mechanism is not connected to intermetallic control or interfacial segregation.
The cited evidence concerns refractory HEA coatings without Mg and therefore does not establish transferability to a lightweight bulk Mg-containing alloy.
Compliance with the density-below-6 g/cm3 requirement after Cr addition is asserted neither by calculation nor measurement.
